in_greek.name: Αυριάνη

in_latin.name: Auriana
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen derivatum ab aurum, quod significat aurum, et suffixo -ana, quod indicat femininum, ostendit connexionem cum valore et splendore auri in ecclesia christiana primitiva

in_english.name: Auriane
in_english.long_meaning: name derived from Latin aurum, meaning gold, and suffix -ane, indicating feminine, reflects connection to value and splendor of gold in early Christian church, symbolizing spiritual wealth and vitality
